dedupe_keys.name: northern ireland mineral prospecting licences and mining leases department for the economy

description: These OpenDataNI datasets give the polygons of mineral prospecting licences and mining leases issued under the Minerals Development Act (Northern Ireland) 1969 by the Department for the Economy. The attribute table holds the licence or lease ID, the holder, the date issued and the expiry date. The prospecting licences are provided as a GeoPackage in Irish National Grid (resource dated 30 September 2025); the mining leases come as Geodatabase, GeoJSON, GeoPackage and KMZ, with GeoJSON and KML in WGS84. A third dataset of prospecting applications states that as of 8 May 2025 there are no applications. All three are published under the UK Open Government Licence and are free to download. Coverage is Northern Ireland; the leases entry was last modified in July 2026. Caveats: the data show legal title only, not whether any extraction takes place, and minerals such as sand and gravel that fall outside the Act are not stated on the page read. For simulation it identifies where mineral exploration and mining rights exist, useful for land-use conflict and future supply scenarios. Related catalogue records include the GSNI GeoIndex minerals layers and BGS BritPits.
